## MarketUtils.getCollateralPower() function

Returns the borrow power of a collateral amount before oracle pricing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function getCollateralPower(collateral: BigIntish, marketParams: {
        lltv: BigIntish;
    }): bigint;
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `marketParams.lltv`<!-- -->: The market liquidation loan-to-value, scaled by WAD.

## Example


```ts
import { MarketUtils } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk";
```
